Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.S. No. 2123/2020

Dear Ms. Karve,

Thank you for meeting us on 22 December 2020 about your dispute with Revathi Shetty. As we understand it, the tenant has sublet the flat without permission.

Our advice is to collect evidence of unauthorised subletting such as utility bills in the occupant's name. Please collect utility bills in the occupant's name and statements of the neighbours and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
